camel_example: aliyun imageseg SegmentCloth --region cn-hangzhou --ImageURL 'http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/imageseg/SegmentCloth/SegmentCloth1.jpg' --ClothClass.1 tops --OutMode 1 --ReturnForm whiteBK
description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the clothing segmentation feature SegmentCloth
description_zh: 本文介绍服饰分割SegmentCloth的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageseg segment-cloth --image-url http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/imageseg/SegmentCloth/SegmentCloth1.jpg --out-mode 1 --cloth-class tops --return-form whiteBK --region cn-hangzhou
name: SegmentCloth

parameters.help_en: The image URL. We recommend using an OSS link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in a non-Shanghai region OSS, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The type of segmentation result to return, which affects the content returned in the ImageURL field. This is an optional parameter.

0 (default): The default main clothing segmentation result.

1: A combined segmentation result of user-specified class categories
parameters.help_zh:
返回分割结果的类型，影响ImageURL字段的返回内容，用户非必选。

0（默认值）：默认的主体服饰分割结果。

1：用户指定class类别的组合分割结果
parameters.name: out_mode

parameters.help_en:
The clothing category. Valid values:
tops: Upper garment
coat: Outerwear
skirt: Skirt/Dress
pants: Trousers
bag: Bag
shoes: Shoes
hat: Hat
parameters.help_zh:
服饰类别，取值范围：
tops：上衣
coat：外套
skirt：裙装
pants：裤装
bag：包类
shoes：鞋子
hat：帽子
parameters.name: cloth_class

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the format of the returned image. Valid values:

whiteBK: Returns a white background image.
mask: Returns a single-channel mask.
If not set, a four-channel PNG image is returned.
This parameter only applies to the output ImageURL. It does not affect ClassUrl, which always returns a mask channel image
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回的图像格式，取值范围：

whiteBK：返回白底图。
mask：返回单通道mask。
如果不设置，则返回四通道PNG图。
该参数的设置只对输出结果的ImageURL有效，对ClassUrl无效，ClassUrl固定返回的是mask通道图
parameters.name: return_form
